name: Pension Zangerl
beschreibung:
History

The Pension Zangerl writes on pension-zangerl.at that it has existed since 1963, for more than 50 years, and is run in the third generation. The family website zangerl-ischgl.at adds that the Zangerl family has run two houses in the heart of Ischgl for over sixty years, the Hotel Zangerl and the Pension Zangerl, immediately next to each other. As owners of the pension the pages name Anna and Josef Zangerl, Dorfstraße 107, 6561 Ischgl, telephone +43 5444 5273, email info@pension-zangerl.at. The hotel stands at Dorfstraße 101. A building history before 1963 is not published by the page. The style is described as genuine Tyrolean style and Tiroler Landhausstil.

Getting there

According to its own statement the pension lies only a few minutes on foot from the valley station of the Silvretta cable car. The run ends behind the house; the houses lie directly on the valley run, the cross-country trail and the hiking and cycling paths of the Silvretta Arena. Restaurants, shops and après-ski bars are said to be in the immediate vicinity. Check-in from 15:00. Anyone arriving after 19:00 should call briefly. Check-out until 10:00. Free parking spaces directly at the pension, plus an electric charging station. A bus or train line number is not given by the page.

Tips

There are single rooms, double rooms and multi-bed rooms, all according to the room page with breakfast included. The single room is described at 22 to 27 square metres for one person, with a single bed, balcony, shower and WC, satellite TV, safe, carpet and Wi-Fi. Double rooms likewise measure about 22 to 27 square metres. Multi-bed rooms for 3 to 4 people measure about 25 to 32 square metres. The breakfast buffet names milk from the family’s own farm and bread from the local baker. The house does not offer lunch or dinner, but refers guests to restaurants nearby. Wi-Fi is free of charge throughout the house. On request the sauna in the Hotel Zangerl may be used. In the house there is a ski cellar with a ski-boot heater. Skis do not belong in the rooms; the booking page says that about the cellar. Pets on request. Prices are per person per night excluding local tax. Up to three nights cost a short-stay surcharge of 4 euros per night per person. The general terms and conditions of the hotel industry apply. The page recommends travel insurance and links to the Europäische. The pension is also open in summer, with hiking and bike routes in the Paznaun. The family describes the Silvretta Arena as a winter-sports area, without fixing a piste-kilometre figure on the pension page.
kurzbeschreibung: Family pension of Anna and Josef Zangerl, Dorfstraße 107 in Ischgl, since 1963, directly on the valley run and a few minutes on foot from the Silvretta cable car.
